title: Meditation on Scripture
definition: Meditation on Scripture is the prayerful dwelling on God's Word so that its truth shapes the heart, mind, desires, and actions.
summary: Biblical meditation is not emptying the mind. It is filling the heart with God's truth and responding in faith.
christFocus: Meditating on Scripture helps believers behold Christ and walk in His ways.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content: Biblical meditation is not emptying the mind. It is filling the heart with God's truth and responding in faith.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: This doctrine matters because it helps believers follow Christ faithfully, understand Scripture clearly, and live with hope, obedience, and discernment.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Receive this truth with humility, bring it into prayer, compare it with Scripture, and let it shape your worship, obedience, endurance, witness, and daily walk with Christ.
